== Source, printing and count verification (Story 386) ==
The Players Committee post linked in the article's Sources (WordPress post 34745) was compared with the [[Media:26Worlds Moss DS IE.txt|wiki-hosted XML download]] and the card identities displayed in the table. The download's File page attributes it to the forum distribution; the original forum ZIP has not been independently byte-verified.
The article contains 60 constructed cards and 29 outside-deck cards. The original download contains 60 constructed entries and 29 outside-deck entries. Its unchanged SHA-256 is <code>9df612fe6a85bb36be29287d471a68a5c2a1d06741420b3dd47db5a22349a68c</code>. Constructed and outside-deck XML identities were checked separately; outside-deck vehicles and starships retain their own type groups.

=== Printing choices ===
* 1x [[Darth Vader, Emperor's Enforcer (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>208_30^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 1x [[Coarse And Rough And Irritating (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>200_109^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
* 1x [[Imperial Decree (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]: XML <nowiki>200_108^</nowiki>. The explicit image modifier is represented by the matching published ALT face.
